description:
A rare balance of city energy and riverside calm, with interior-designed homes, stand-out amenities and green space woven into everyday life. It's all supported by a team that knows your name, creating a community where London feels more liveable, connected and considered. 

 Experience redefined modern living in Nine Elms, London at Moda, Embassy Boulevard. Just a short walk from the iconic Battersea Power Station, moments from the Thames, Nine Elms Underground station and Vauxhall station, this is Zone 1 living at its most connected.  

Set within a thriving riverside neighbourhood, you'll find the U.S. Embassy and TopJaw-featured Darby's restaurant on your doorstep, alongside the beautifully landscaped Seven-acre Linear Park, a rare stretch of green space in central London, perfect for walking, relaxing, and connecting with nature. 

Embassy Boulevard offers state-of-the-art rental homes with an exceptional range of resident amenities, including a 24-hour gym, resident lounges, co-working spaces, library, games room, screening room, private dining room, roof terraces, and outdoor play areas. 

At Moda, we don't just offer a place to live - we create a lifestyle. From pet-friendly spaces and exclusive resident events, everything is designed so you can focus on living your best Moda life. 

OUR APARTMENT 

- Open-plan two-bed apartment with dedicated living space for media unit, sofa and lounge chair 

- Comfort cooling and underfloor heating 

- House bathroom with rainfall shower 

- Living area with plush two-seater sofa and armchair 

- Fitted kitchen with Samsung appliances and dining space for four 

- Large utility cupboard for additional storage and dedicated entrance hallway 

 

YOUR KITCHEN 

Sleek and modern fitted kitchen with Samsung appliances and dining space for two. 

 

YOUR LIVING AREA 

Open-plan, light and spacious, with floor-to-ceiling windows drawing natural light and epic views. Space to relax with a dedicated dining area with a coffered ceiling and linear LED lighting. 

 

YOUR BEDROOMS 

2 x double bedrooms with ottoman bed and floor-to-ceiling fitted wardrobes 

 

YOUR BATHROOM 

Contemporary porcelain tiling throughout, deluxe-sized rainfall shower and separate handheld shower, heated towel rail, and bespoke bathroom cabinet with vanity lighting.  

 

WHY CHOOSE MODA 

Moda is the UK's leading rental brand, with neighbourhoods across seven cities. Recently named Operator of the Year, we're proud to be one of the highest-rated providers on HomeViews-an independent platform where residents share honest feedback on their living experience. 

 

* Images are for illustrative purposes only and layouts, finishes, and specifications may vary. Subject to availability. T&Cs apply.* 

Please note that utilities (including electricity, water, and heating, depending on your apartment), council tax, TV licence, parking (if required), and any optional extras or upgraded services are not included within your monthly rent.
 

Ready to step into a new standard of renting?  Book your viewing today and discover life at Moda, Embassy Boulevard. Speak to our team to discuss the homes and offers currently available.


Follow us @embassyboulevard
